actions.action: Tap a new leaf over white paper to look for thrips
Place a blue sticky trap beside the pothos for 3 days and check it
Spray spinosad on all pothos, philodendrons and syngoniums every 7 days for 3 weeks
Soil drench once with an imidacloprid systemic product such as Bonide
Cut off badly damaged new leaves and bin them
Wipe remaining leaves with a damp cloth weekly

reason: The answer names thrips as the main cause and recommends the same systemic Bonide soil treatment and leaf removal that fixed the plant; the extra spinosad spray is not harmful.
